archived_by: repo hygiene — Profile B residual archive (git slim plan)

residual_findings.title: No concurrent dispatch / re-entrancy test for CapabilityRegistry
residual_findings.scope: test modules in host_tool_executor.rs and capability_registry.rs
residual_findings.note: Registry dispatch is &self and handlers are fn pointers — concurrent safety assumed via existing workspace/DB isolation, not proven by new tests. Low risk for V1.53 P0.

residual_findings.title: No separate admission test for Schedule caller_kind (dispatch_for_schedule is a thin wrapper)
residual_findings.note: By design (per R-V153P0-002); E2E in agent_tool_production_wiring covers one tool. Broader Schedule caller-kind coverage deferred.

residual_findings.title: DaemonToolDispatchAdapter documentation — by-design delegation through dispatch_for_schedule (not a bypass)
residual_findings.scope: crates/nexus-orchestration/src/host_tool_dispatch_adapter.rs (or equivalent) — adapter delegates to dispatch_for_schedule → execute → registry_dispatch by design
residual_findings.target: V1.53 P1 (when P1 adds new tools) or P-last spec hygiene
residual_findings.note: Add a doc comment on DaemonToolDispatchAdapter explaining it routes through dispatch_for_schedule → execute() → registry_dispatch → CapabilityRegistry, and is by design not a bypass. Prevents future reviewers from mis-flagging it as a security gap.
residual_findings.closure_note: T7: DaemonToolDispatchAdapter doc with LazyLock chain note

residual_findings.title: Per-dispatch CapabilityRegistry allocation on schedule hot path (registry rebuilt on every call)
residual_findings.note: Acceptable for V1.53 (≤8 tools, single-daemon). Deferred optimization: cache via once_cell::sync::Lazy<CapabilityRegistry> or std::sync::LazyLock singleton; add Criterion benchmark to measure improvement.

residual_findings.title: Missing dispatch-latency benchmark for match→HashMap cutover
residual_findings.note: Add Criterion benchmark before/with the caching optimization to quantify improvement.

residual_findings.title: V1.53 P1 — Cross-validation test only checks nexus./fs/ prefix, not catalog↔registry id bijection asserted in capability-registry.md §2.1
residual_findings.note: P1 should add a strict catalog↔registry id bijection test (every catalog id has a registry row; every registry id has a catalog entry). Spec text already claims this invariant; test does not enforce it.

residual_findings.title: V1.53 P1 — Parity coverage narrow — only 2 of 8 tools have explicit parity tests (whoami, workspace.info)
residual_findings.note: P1 (DF-46 read slice) adds 5 new read-heavy nexus.* tools and should expand parity/regression coverage to all 8 existing tools in the same plan.
residual_findings.closure_note: T10: All 19 tools have parity/regression coverage

residual_findings.title: Admission vectors could be &'static [AdmissionGate] instead of Vec (remove per-row heap allocation)
residual_findings.note: Low-risk future cleanup; gates are immutable and known at compile time.
